name: qz-aidlc
description: QualiZeal AI-DLC Studio: tested starters for LangGraph, the OpenAI Agents SDK, the Claude Agent SDK, an MCP server, agent memory, text-to-SQL, a command line agents drive tools through, AWS Strands, Microsoft Agent Framework and Go; vectorless and hybrid RAG kits with cited answers, gates and web pages; a board for several agents on one job; lanes to architect, spec with fresh-eyes review, build, evaluate, test, audit, deliver, demo, bid and write office decks and mail; routing that fits the model and effort to the task; a guard that reads every command on a line and scores the risk of each action, writes made once per run, a credential proxy so agents never hold tokens, two-way test sync with Azure DevOps and Jira, per-turn undo, goal mode, a GitHub agent, publishing that saves locally first, an audit chain, run ledger, report cards and a bench that replays the harness against every release.

github_token.title: GitHub token
github_token.description: Fine-grained token for QualiZeal repositories (contents and pull requests: read and write). Stored in secure storage.

atlassian_site.title: Atlassian site
atlassian_site.description: Your Jira/Confluence site, for example aicoe-genq.atlassian.net

atlassian_email.title: Atlassian e-mail
atlassian_email.description: Used only by Knowledge Fabric ingestion from Confluence.

atlassian_token.title: Atlassian API token
atlassian_token.description: Used only by Knowledge Fabric ingestion from Confluence. Stored in secure storage.

pricing_workbook.title: Pricing workbook path
pricing_workbook.description: Full path to your copy of the SEG pricing workbook (.xlsm). Read only by the pricing tool; never shown in the conversation.

kf_home.title: Knowledge Fabric folder
kf_home.description: Folder for the Knowledge Fabric index. Leave empty for ~/.qz/kf, or point at a team share.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: How Claude writes to you in these sessions: normal, terse or grunt. Questions that need your yes, warnings and anything a client reads stay in full sentences.

plan.title: Claude plan
plan.description: pro, max, ultra, team-standard, team-premium, enterprise or api. Routing uses it to judge how much is in hand; Pro, Max and Ultra also report usage to the status line.

format_on_edit.title: Format on edit
format_on_edit.description: on or off. When on, a file Claude writes is formatted by the formatter the project declares (prettier, biome, ruff, black, gofmt), if it is installed. Nothing is downloaded.
